findings.problem: 72 cells against the 51-cell picker column (pre-commit 49; en 74). The 51-cell cut lands after '--switc', so the --switch/--window half is truncated in the picker while the <message> clause — the half UR-SLASH-B1 exists to protect — stays fully visible, because this value front-loads it and the English does not. findings.suggestion: Keep as-is and record the overrun; do not shorten to 51 — every 51-cell variant I tried drops either the <message> clause or a flag. If the budget is genuinely hard, raise the column, not the copy.

findings.problem: 55 cells (pre-commit exactly 51, at budget; en 66). Restoring نام/pid (round-1 M2) cost 4 cells, so the tail '؛ /resume کھولے' now clips in the picker. The truncation eats only that secondary clause; the selector clause (this / another by name-pid / all) stays visible. findings.suggestion: سیشن بند: یہ، دوسرا (نام/pid) یا سب؛ /resume کھولے — 50 cells, fits, at the cost of the finite imperative (بند کریں → بند). Prefer this only if the 51-cell column is enforced; otherwise keep the fuller imperative and accept a clipped /resume clause, as English does at 66.
